name: get_metadata
title: Get item metadata
description: Get structured properties of a single entry: bibliographic metadata, abstract, annotations, child notes, and citation formats.

include.description: Sections to return. Returns only requested sections.

citationStyle.description: CSL style name, e.g. "apa". Only used when citationFormat=formatted.

max_tokens.description: Token ceiling. Notes are returned in full until the budget is hit, then truncated with truncated/fullLength flags.
